description: Election Commission - A. V. Shiva was Selected as the member of the Colombo M/C - S. G. D. A. Virosan was Selected as the member of the Dimbulagala P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Colombo Municipal Council and Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignation and death of elected members. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of new members to fill these vacancies. This falls directly under election-related matters, specifically addressing electoral procedures for local government positions.
